author: Ismokecrack
body:
Dear Avicus Network,
Today I was playing on my account "ChickenNMayo" (it used to be called "niterider11") and I was banned whilst playing on one of your maps. I am confused on why I was banned because I don't own/use any hacks or clients other then "Minecraft". I was making stairs above the map to get to the other side and I was building across to the other teams base just before I was banned. I live in Australia and I believe this is an American server and I don't have any clue as to why I was banned. I would be very pleased if you could look into why I was banned and if there is any footage may I please see. This is the first time I have used this website and I hope its the last time I am sending letters for me to be unbanned. I was once banned on a server for swearing but I don't recall swearing on this server because I learnt my lesson.

From ChickenNMayo.

title: Appeal An Infraction

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello ChickenNMayo,

The evidence for your ban can be found here: https://youtu.be/BCE8un5XSkY
Our staff team will review the evidence further, and you will receive a final response from a senior staff member concerning your appeal soon.

Thank you for your patience.

Sincerely,
FrostedCupcakez

replies.author: Gundham
replies.body:
Greetings, ChickenNMayo.

The evidence provided is valid. You were caught hacking and you will not be appealed. Hopefully this serves to you as a lesson. Do not file in any more appeals until at least six months have passed ever since your punishment was issued.

Sincerely,
- Vinnx | Senior Moderator
